policy.reviewer: single agent visual review; not independently human-adjudicated
policy.reference_process: All 168 photos viewed, notes and accepted aliases frozen before loading detailed saved predictions for scoring. Same agent previously knew aggregate pipeline fill counts; not a double-blind independent-expert benchmark.
policy.unknown: Unknown is unscorable, including no visible vintage or finer origin; never counted as correct blank. No known-absent targets in v1.
policy.geography: Country uses state for US wines. Origin can be inferred from visible appellation, not estate reputation or bottler address. Region is wine region, valley at Region level. Notes distinguish printed origin from inference; field basis for country/region intentionally permits either, not a verbatim-text claim.
policy.identity: Primary visible estate/brand, not automatic legal bottler. Explicit maker above legal bottler wording can own a distinctive wine name. Printed parent producer alternatives are listed. No distinct cuvée: use appellation/varietal, not estate duplicated as wine name.
policy.aliases: Exact normalized equality against listed aliases only; no substring/fuzzy matching. Case, accents, whitespace, punctuation ignored; & and et equivalent. Producer prefixes may be omitted only where generated from a prefixed reference, never added to an unprefixed brand. Generic range/classification omissions only as listed; named cuvées retained. Appellation qualifiers such as Grand Cru are not globally stripped.
policy.grouping: Same reviewed six-field identity including vintage; unscored fields remain unknown. Groups express matching visible identities, NOT proven same physical bottles. Different vintages separate; undated repeated identities cannot prove vintage equivalence. No propagation of missing targets between photos.
policy.fully_correct: All six targets known AND all six outputs correct. Ineligible images are reported separately; all-known-field success is not full six-field correctness.
policy.scope: Development diagnostic for frozen existing Android outputs, not held-out or geographically representative accuracy. All original 168 images retained including uncertain product category 101.
